'''2018 European Championship Day 3 Ziemowit Skwara LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ziemowit Skwara]] at [[2018 European Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Ziemowit Skwara]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open TRM Skwara LS 2018 EC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
